        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>forward</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="L_acc" name="Accounting Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>identify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>checkitems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>clarify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>forward2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>resolve</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>pay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>close</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>m1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>m2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>audit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>approve</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>amount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L_board" name="Board">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>checkb</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>m3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Invoice received" />
    <bpmn:task id="receive" name="Receive the invoice in the central inbox" />
